content: Youth diagnosed with type 2 diabetes should undergo a comprehensive foot examination on an annual basis. This evaluation must include the assessment of foot pulses to check for adequate blood flow, pinprick sensation to evaluate small nerve fiber function, vibration sensation using a 128-Hz tuning fork to assess large nerve fiber function, and monofilament testing to detect loss of protective sensation. Additionally, ankle reflex tests should be performed to assess the integrity of the reflex arc. Preventive strategies should prioritize achieving optimal glycemic control to minimize the risk of developing diabetic neuropathy.
